title.zh: 利雅德機場10/25二度重開、不到24小時內再遭飛彈瞄準——19家航空公司的停飛賭注再次贏了，布蘭特衝上113.17美元五個月新高，10/28 FOMC要在這個訊號前做決定；烏克蘭電網10/26單日6州輪流限電，10/18報告『與期中選舉脫鉤』的判斷持續成立；Oracle十月季更一口氣修1,295個漏洞、6個滿分弱點；PHP2Shell新增兩筆實證——蜜罐證實攻擊早於揭露4天發動，五國政府網站已搶先下線
title.en: Riyadh's Airport Reopens a Second Time on 10/25, Then Takes a Missile Within 24 Hours — the 19 Airlines That Refused to Fly Back Are Vindicated Again as Brent Hits $113.17, a Five-Month High, Right Before the Fed's 10/28 Rate Call; Ukraine's Grid Rotates Outages Across Six Regions on 10/26, Keeping 10/18's 'Decoupled From the Midterms' Call Intact; Oracle's October Update Fixes 1,295 Flaws Including Six Perfect Scores; PHP2Shell Gets Two New Data Points — Honeypots Confirm Exploitation Began Four Days Before Disclosure, and Five Governments Already Pulled Sites Offline

focus.zh: 本期涵蓋10/26-10/28。利雅德King Khalid國際機場10/18首次依NOTAM A3650/26重開後，隨即被10/24-25報告記錄的本輪最大規模多點攻勢再度打到關閉；沙烏地當局10/25第二次宣布重開，但不到24小時內胡塞再次宣稱以彈道飛彈瞄準機場，沙國防部發言人Turki al-Maliki證實『攔截一枚彈道飛彈』，未證實有無命中或損害——10/22報告與10/26報告建立的『機場重開不代表風險解除』判斷，這次連『重開』這個動作本身都撐不過一天。Riyadh Air已把部分客運業務轉移到蓋西姆省的Prince Naif機場，Lufthansa、British Airways、KLM、Qatar Airways等十餘家國際航空公司的停飛公告延伸到10/25重開期之後；ING與Commerzbank的分析把布蘭特原油的風險溢價直接歸因於這一系列對沙國石油基礎設施的攻擊，Kpler船運追蹤顯示兩週內至少18艘船隻遭到攻擊，布蘭特10/22收在113.17美元、五個月新高。這些發展與本站10/26週報的核心論點(戰爭險的自動終止條款讓保單比軍艦更快關閉一條航線)屬同一個機制在另一個案例上實際上演——只是這次的主角是商用航空保險，不是海運LNG保險；而這個機制正好撞上10/28的FOMC利率決定，油價訊號是『供給面衝擊』還是『需求面過熱』，會直接影響Fed這次怎麼讀通膨。另一條線，烏克蘭電網10/26單日在第聶伯羅彼得羅夫斯克、頓內茨克、札波羅熱、車尼希夫、哈爾科夫、蘇梅六州執行輪流限電與工業限電，Ukrenergo的官方通報把10/18報告建立的『俄軍戰場烈度與美國期中選舉政治日曆脫鉤』判斷再往後推了一期，沒有任何鬆動跡象。資安端，Oracle 10月季度安全更新(CPU)修補1,295個漏洞(1,209個不重複CVE)，其中95個列為重大、6個拿下CVSS滿分10.0——分布在E-Business Suite、SOA Suite(3筆)與Access Manager，Oracle官方目前未將任何一筆列為已遭在野利用，與本站近月追蹤的Cisco、Citrix、NetScaler系列『揭露當下就已在被利用』的Tier-0案例形成對照，值得作為『已修補但尚未武器化』的指標持續觀察。另外，本站10/24報告與10/26報告已兩次收錄的PHP2Shell(CVE-2026-109618、CVE-2026-109619)，這次新增兩筆此前未記錄的事實：Amazon的MadPot誘捕系統證實攻擊者早在10/17——正式揭露與修補的4天前——就已嘗試利用，代表這起事件從一開始就是真正的在野零時差，而非『揭露後才被武器化』；同時，澳洲、法國、芬蘭、丹麥、荷蘭至少五國已主動將政府網站下線作為預防措施，這是本站首次記錄到『尚無證實入侵案例、但已有國家級機構選擇主動斷線』的制度性回應模式。本期沒有找到本站通常追蹤的APT歸因報告、台海例行以外的軍事動態、或新的出口管制措施在過去48小時內有實質進展，訊號密度集中在這四條線上，故本期僅收錄5條，低於常態的6-8條。
focus.en: This period covers 10/26-10/28. Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, first reopened on 10/18 under NOTAM A3650/26, was struck closed again by the largest multi-site Houthi wave of this conflict, logged in the 10/24-25 reports. Saudi authorities announced a second reopening on 10/25, but within 24 hours the Houthis again claimed a ballistic-missile strike on the airport, with Saudi defense ministry spokesman Turki al-Maliki confirming 'one ballistic missile intercepted' without confirming any impact or damage — the 'reopening doesn't mean the risk is resolved' judgment this site set in its 10/22 and 10/26 reports now can't survive even one full day past the reopening itself. Riyadh Air has shifted some passenger operations to Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport in Qassim province, and a dozen-plus international carriers — Lufthansa, British Airways, KLM, Qatar Airways among them — have extended suspensions past the 10/25 reopening window. ING's and Commerzbank's analysis attributes Brent's risk premium directly to this strike campaign against Saudi oil infrastructure; Kpler's shipping-tracking data shows at least 18 vessels attacked in two weeks, and Brent closed at $113.17 on 10/22, a five-month high. These developments are the same mechanism this site's 10/26 weekly described (a war-risk insurance auto-termination clause can close a route faster than a navy can) playing out live in a different case — commercial aviation insurance here, rather than maritime LNG insurance — and it lands right before the Fed's 10/28 rate decision, where whether this oil signal reads as a supply shock or demand overheating will shape how the Fed treats inflation this round. Separately, Ukraine's grid underwent rotating and industrial power-limiting outages across six regions (Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, Chernihiv, Kharkiv, Sumy) on 10/26; Ukrenergo's official notices push the 10/18 report's 'Russia's battlefield intensity is decoupled from the US midterm political calendar' judgment one more cycle forward with no sign of easing. On cyber, Oracle's October Critical Patch Update fixed 1,295 vulnerabilities (1,209 unique CVEs), 95 rated critical, with six hitting a perfect CVSS 10.0 — spread across E-Business Suite, SOA Suite (three), and Access Manager; Oracle has not flagged any as exploited in the wild, a contrast worth tracking against this site's recent run of Cisco/Citrix/NetScaler Tier-0 cases that were already being exploited at disclosure — this one is a 'patched but not yet weaponized' marker. And PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619), already logged twice in this site's 10/24 and 10/26 reports, gains two previously unrecorded facts this cycle: Amazon's MadPot honeypot system confirms exploitation attempts as early as 10/17 — four days before the formal disclosure and patch — meaning this was a genuine in-the-wild zero-day from the start, not something weaponized only after disclosure; and at least five governments (Australia, France, Finland, Denmark, Netherlands) have proactively taken government websites offline as a precaution, the first case this site has logged of a state-level institutional response occurring before any confirmed breach. This cycle turned up no new APT attribution report, no Taiwan Strait military development beyond routine patrols, and no material 48-hour progress on export controls, so signal density concentrated on these four threads — this brief carries 5 items, below the usual 6-8.

title.zh: 利雅德機場10/25二度重開不到24小時再遭飛彈瞄準，布蘭特衝上113.17美元五個月新高——戰爭險把一條商用航線關掉的速度，這次比10/26週報描述的LNG航運案例更快，而且剛好撞上10/28 FOMC
title.en: Riyadh's Airport Takes a Missile Within 24 Hours of Its Second 10/25 Reopening as Brent Hits $113.17, a Five-Month High — War-Risk Insurance Is Closing a Commercial Air Route Even Faster Than the 10/26 Weekly's LNG-Shipping Case, Right Before the Fed's 10/28 Decision

summary.zh: King Khalid國際機場10/18依NOTAM A3650/26(無到期日)首次重開後，被10/24-25報告記錄的本輪最大規模多點攻勢(三座機場加一座空軍基地、延布與拉比格油源同時被點名)打回關閉。沙國當局10/25第二次宣布恢復運作，但不到24小時內，胡塞發言人Yahya Saree再次宣稱以彈道飛彈瞄準機場，沙國防部發言人Turki al-Maliki證實『攔截一枚彈道飛彈』，但未證實有無命中或造成損害——這種『官方只證實攔截、不證實是否被突破』的表態模式，與10/12那次造成13死逾300傷的攻擊事後調查(沙國至今仍在檢討攔截系統為何沒能提前預警)屬同一種溝通風格。Riyadh Air已把部分客運航班轉移到蓋西姆省的Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz國際機場；Lufthansa公開將停飛延到11/18，British Airways與KLM原本預計要到10月底才評估復飛，Qatar Airways則是無限期暫停利雅德與達曼兩地航線——這些公告早於這次最新攻擊就已存在，代表航空業者的內部保險與安全評估，從10/18第一次重開起就沒有真正跟著官方NOTAM同步。ING與Commerzbank的原物料分析師把布蘭特原油的風險溢價直接歸因於這一系列對沙國石油基礎設施(含延布、拉比格)的攻擊；船運追蹤機構Kpler的數據顯示兩週內至少18艘船隻在相關海域遭到攻擊；布蘭特10/22收在113.17美元，為5月以來新高，且正朝第三個連續上漲週前進。另有報導稱Aramco已下令疏散其達蘭(Dhahran)總部，但路透社未能獨立查證，沙國當局也未證實胡塞對延布與利雅德機場個別攻擊的具體聲明，這部分應視為未經證實。美國聯準會10/28召開本輪利率決策會議，是否把這波油價訊號讀為應對的『供給面衝擊』(傾向忽略)或『需求面疊加通膨壓力』(傾向緊縮)，會是這次會後聲明的關鍵分歧點。
summary.en: King Khalid International Airport first reopened on 10/18 under NOTAM A3650/26 (no expiry date), only to be struck closed again by the largest multi-site Houthi wave of this conflict — logged in the 10/24-25 reports — which hit three airports, an air base, and the Yanbu and Rabigh oil sites simultaneously. Saudi authorities announced a second reopening on 10/25, but within 24 hours Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree again claimed a ballistic-missile strike on the airport, with Saudi defense ministry spokesman Turki al-Maliki confirming 'one ballistic missile intercepted' without confirming any impact or damage — this pattern of officially confirming only the intercept, never whether anything got through, mirrors the same communication style seen in the aftermath investigation of the 10/12 strike that killed at least 13 and wounded 300+ (Saudi Arabia is still probing why its air-defense systems failed to give earlier warning). Riyadh Air has shifted some passenger flights to Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport in Qassim province; Lufthansa has publicly extended its suspension to 11/18, British Airways and KLM had already said they wouldn't reassess resumption until at least late October, and Qatar Airways suspended Riyadh and Dammam indefinitely — all of these announcements predate this latest strike, meaning carriers' internal insurance and safety assessments have not actually tracked the official NOTAM timeline since the very first 10/18 reopening. ING's and Commerzbank's commodity analysts attribute Brent's risk premium directly to this strike campaign against Saudi oil infrastructure (including Yanbu and Rabigh); shipping-tracker Kpler's data shows at least 18 vessels attacked in relevant waters over two weeks; Brent closed at $113.17 on 10/22, a high since May, heading toward a third straight weekly gain. Separate reporting says Aramco ordered an evacuation of its Dhahran headquarters, though Reuters could not independently verify this, and Saudi authorities have not confirmed the Houthis' specific claims of strikes on Yanbu and the airport individually — this detail should be treated as unverified. The US Federal Reserve holds its rate decision on 10/28, and whether it reads this oil signal as a supply shock (leaning toward looking through it) or as inflation pressure stacking onto demand (leaning hawkish) will be the key fault line in the post-meeting statement.

implication.zh: 10/22報告與10/26報告建立的判斷方法論是：『機場宣布重開不代表風險解除，法律重開與航空公司實際排班是兩個獨立時鐘』——這次的新進展把這個判斷再往前推一步：連『法律重開』這個時鐘本身，這次都撐不滿24小時就被打破了。對你跟決策者對話時最直接可用的一句話是：這次不是『航空公司比較保守、官方比較樂觀』的資訊落差問題，而是雙方其實在描述同一件事的不同截面——官方的NOTAM只回答『法律上是否允許起降』，不回答『軍事上這個目標是否還在清單上』，而後者從10/18第一次重開到現在，答案從未改變過是『仍在清單上』。這也是本站10/26週報『戰爭險自動終止條款比軍艦更快關閉一條航線』這個論點，第一次在商用航空保險(而非原本討論的海運LNG保險)上看到幾乎同構的實例：多家航空公司的停飛公告時間點，明顯早於且獨立於任何一次官方NOTAM重開宣布，代表承保方與風控部門用的判斷依據，從一開始就不是政府的法律狀態宣告，而是攻擊方自己公開承認的目標清單——這給你一個更好的框架去評估台灣或其他地緣熱點『基礎設施宣布恢復』類新聞：真正該追蹤的先行指標不是政府公告，是保險與承保市場的實際定價行為，後者永遠領先前者。對威脅獵攻/台股操作的綜合意義：布蘭特風險溢價與10/28 FOMC的利率決定在時間上疊加，若Fed選擇把油價訊號解讀為供給面衝擊而暫緩升息，等於是在間接承認『中東的戰爭經濟學正在影響美國貨幣政策』——這個因果鏈過去幾期的9/18報告已經點出『價格波動是訊息驅動、不是真實降溫』的模式，這次要驗證的是：反過來，真實升級是否真的能驅動Fed的決策邏輯，還是Fed會像過去處理地緣油價衝擊一樣『穿透』它。下一個查核點是10/28 FOMC會後聲明的通膨措辭，以及Lufthansa等航司是否在11/18這個自訂日期到達前又再延長停飛。
implication.en: The methodological judgment this site built across the 10/22 and 10/26 reports was: 'an airport announcing reopening doesn't mean the risk is resolved — legal reopening and airlines' actual scheduling are two independent clocks.' This cycle's development pushes that one step further: even the 'legal reopening' clock itself couldn't survive 24 hours intact this time. The single most useful sentence for a conversation with a decision-maker is this: this isn't a case of airlines being conservative while officials are optimistic — both sides are describing different facets of the same fact. The official NOTAM only answers 'is takeoff/landing legally permitted,' never 'is this target still on the attacker's list' — and the answer to the latter question, from the first 10/18 reopening until now, has never changed from 'yes.' This is also the first time the 10/26 weekly's thesis — that a war-risk insurance auto-termination clause can close a route faster than a navy — shows up in an almost structurally identical case in commercial aviation insurance rather than the maritime LNG insurance it originally discussed: multiple carriers' suspension announcements clearly predate and are independent of any official NOTAM reopening, meaning underwriters' and risk teams' actual decision inputs were never the government's legal-status declarations to begin with — they were the attacker's own publicly acknowledged target list. That gives you a sharper frame for evaluating 'infrastructure declared restored' stories around Taiwan or other geopolitical hotspots: the real leading indicator isn't the government announcement, it's actual pricing behavior in the insurance and underwriting market, which always moves first. For threat-hunting and Taiwan-equities purposes together: Brent's risk premium is now stacking in time against the Fed's 10/28 rate call — if the Fed reads the oil signal as a supply shock and holds off tightening, that's an indirect admission that Middle East war economics is shaping US monetary policy. The 9/18 report already flagged the pattern that 'price swings are news-driven, not genuine de-escalation' — what needs testing now is the reverse: whether genuine escalation can actually drive the Fed's decision logic, or whether the Fed will look through it the way it has with past geopolitical oil shocks, as before. The next checkpoints are the inflation language in the 10/28 FOMC statement, and whether Lufthansa and others extend their suspensions again before reaching their own self-set 11/18 date.

counterpoint.zh: 布蘭特的風險溢價其實從10/12那次造成重大傷亡的攻擊後就已經開始累積，本次10/25重開後再遭攻擊的『新訊息含量』可能有限——市場在過去兩週已經把『利雅德機場反覆遭攻擊』這個基本模式price in，這次事件更像是對既有判斷的又一次確認，而非真正改變市場定價的新變數；同樣地，FOMC過去面對地緣驅動的油價尖峰，多次選擇『穿透』處理而非直接反應，9/18報告記錄的正是這種模式，因此『油價衝擊影響10/28決策』這個因果鏈本身仍待驗證，不宜預設Fed這次會不一樣。
counterpoint.en: Brent's risk premium has actually been building since the 10/12 strike that caused major casualties, so this latest post-10/25-reopening attack may carry limited new informational content — markets have likely already priced in the basic pattern of 'Riyadh airport keeps getting hit again' over the past two weeks, making this event more a re-confirmation of an existing read than a genuinely new pricing variable. Likewise, the Fed has repeatedly chosen to look through geopolitically driven oil spikes rather than react directly — the exact pattern the 9/18 report logged — so the causal chain from 'oil shock' to '10/28 decision' remains unproven, and there's no strong reason to assume the Fed breaks that pattern this time.

items.source: Associated Press（經Manila Times、ABC News轉述）、ING／Commerzbank大宗商品分析（經Engineering News、FXStreet轉述）、Kpler船運追蹤數據

title.zh: 烏克蘭電網10/26單日6州輪流限電、工業限電同步擴大——10/18報告『俄軍戰場烈度與美國期中選舉脫鉤』的判斷又撐過一期
title.en: Ukraine's Grid Rotates Outages Across Six Regions on 10/26 With Industrial Power-Limiting Expanding in Parallel — the 10/18 Report's 'Russia's Intensity Is Decoupled From the US Midterms' Call Survives Another Cycle

summary.zh: 烏克蘭國家電網公司Ukrenergo 10/26官方通報：第聶伯羅彼得羅夫斯克、頓內茨克、札波羅熱、車尼希夫、哈爾科夫、蘇梅六州同日執行輪流限電，部分地區每日最多兩輪，工業限電排程同步延續至當日結束，搶修人力僅在安全狀況允許處才能作業。這是10/23(八州限電)後一週內第二次全國性多州同時限電，10/18報告已引用本站同期建立的週級量化基準(約1,600枚滑翔炸彈、48枚飛彈、近2,300架攻擊無人機)，本次10/26的通報屬於同一波持續性攻勢的延續，而非單一新事件，故本條僅作為量化基準的持續驗證收錄，不重複列出週級總數。
summary.en: Ukraine's national grid operator Ukrenergo reported officially on 10/26 that Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, Chernihiv, Kharkiv, and Sumy oblasts all underwent rotating outages the same day, with some areas seeing up to two rounds daily; industrial power-limiting schedules continued through the day, and repair crews could only work where security conditions allowed. This is the second nationwide multi-region simultaneous outage within a week, following an eight-region outage on 10/23. The 10/18 report already cited this site's weekly quantified baseline for this period (roughly 1,600 glide bombs, 48 missiles, nearly 2,300 attack drones); the 10/26 notice is a continuation of the same sustained campaign rather than a discrete new event, so this item is logged only as ongoing confirmation of that baseline, without re-tallying weekly totals.

implication.zh: 10/18報告的nexus判斷是：『期中選舉前，美方行政團隊在部分議題上應預期象徵性、低承諾成本的動作，但這不代表俄烏戰場本身的物理烈度會收斂』。10/26這次六州同步限電，加上一週內第二次多州同時斷電的頻率，給這個判斷又增加一個可持續比對的資料點——對你做威脅獵捕與態勢判斷的操作意義是：如果未來幾期這類『多州同時限電』的頻率明顯下降(例如從每週兩次降到每月一次)，才真正代表某種外部壓力(嚴冬彈藥庫存見底、或外交斡旋出現實質進展)真的在起作用；只要頻率維持現狀或上升，『期中選舉後俄烏戰場會緩和』這類基於美國政治日曆的預期，在這條戰線上應該持續被排除，不需要每期重新驗證一次同一件事。
implication.en: The 10/18 report's nexus judgment was: 'ahead of the midterms, expect the US administration to take symbolic, low-commitment-cost actions on some fronts — but that doesn't mean the physical intensity of the Russia-Ukraine battlefield itself will converge.' This 10/26 six-region simultaneous outage, plus the fact that this is the second multi-region simultaneous blackout within a single week, adds another comparable data point to that judgment. The operational takeaway for threat-hunting and situational assessment: if the frequency of 'multi-region simultaneous outages' visibly drops in coming cycles (say, from twice a week to once a month), that would be the real signal that some external pressure — winter ammunition stocks running low, or genuine diplomatic progress — is actually taking effect. As long as the frequency holds or rises, expectations that 'the Russia-Ukraine front will ease after the midterms,' based on the US political calendar, should keep being ruled out on this front without needing re-verification every cycle.

title.zh: Oracle十月季度安全更新一次修補1,295個漏洞、6個拿下CVSS滿分10.0——分布在E-Business Suite、SOA Suite與Access Manager，官方目前未列任何一筆已遭在野利用
title.en: Oracle's October Critical Patch Update Fixes 1,295 Flaws Including Six Perfect CVSS-10.0 Scores — Spread Across E-Business Suite, SOA Suite and Access Manager, With None Yet Flagged Exploited in the Wild

summary.zh: Oracle 10月季度安全更新(Critical Patch Update, CPU)修補1,295個弱點，對應1,209個不重複CVE，其中95個被列為重大(Critical)等級。Oracle Fusion Middleware單一產品線就拿下206個修補，其中134個可在未經身分驗證的情況下被遠端利用。6個CVSS v3.1滿分10.0的漏洞分別落在：Oracle E-Business Suite(CVE-2026-101809)、Oracle SOA Suite(CVE-2026-91231、CVE-2026-91216、CVE-2026-91221，共3筆)、以及Oracle Access Manager(CVE-2026-87337)。資安業者Tenable的分析(經SecurityWeek轉述)指出，Oracle官方在這次CPU公告中沒有把任何一筆列為已遭在野利用(no evidence of exploitation)——這點與本站近月持續追蹤的Cisco、Citrix、NetScaler系列邊界設備案例(多半是『揭露當下就已被利用』甚至『揭露前就已遭利用』)形成明顯對照。Oracle下一次季度CPU排定11/17、12/15，再下一次則是明年1/19。
summary.en: Oracle's October Critical Patch Update (CPU) fixed 1,295 vulnerabilities across 1,209 unique CVEs, with 95 rated Critical. Oracle Fusion Middleware alone accounted for 206 fixes, 134 of which are remotely exploitable without authentication. Six flaws hit a perfect CVSS v3.1 score of 10.0: Oracle E-Business Suite (CVE-2026-101809), Oracle SOA Suite (CVE-2026-91231, CVE-2026-91216, CVE-2026-91221 — three flaws), and Oracle Access Manager (CVE-2026-87337). Security firm Tenable's analysis, relayed via SecurityWeek, notes that Oracle's own CPU announcement flagged none of these as exploited in the wild — a notable contrast to this site's recent run of Cisco, Citrix, and NetScaler edge-device cases, most of which were already being exploited at disclosure or even before it. Oracle's next quarterly CPUs are scheduled for 11/17 and 12/15, with the following one on 1/19 next year.

implication.zh: 對你跟決策者對話時的操作意義：先把這起事件和本站近月的Tier-0邊界設備案例(Cisco Secure Email Gateway、Citrix NetScaler、Ivanti VPN等)做一次明確區分——後面這些案例的共同特徵是『漏洞揭露時攻擊者已經在用』，而這次Oracle的6個滿分弱點，依官方現有說法屬於『先被發現並修補，之後才可能被武器化』的傳統模式。這個區別本身就是一個值得你帶進威脅獵捕優先順序的判斷依據：E-Business Suite與Access Manager這類涉及財務流程與身分治理(SSO)的核心系統，一旦被證實進入在野利用階段，其價值(對攻擊者而言)會高於單純的邊界VPN設備，因為前者直接觸及財務紀錄與橫向移動的身分基礎建設。對你自己或客戶環境的操作意義：現在正是『修補視窗還沒被攻破』的黃金期，下一期查核的重點應該是這6個CVSS 10.0漏洞中，是否有任何一個在未來2-4週內被CISA列入KEV(已遭利用)目錄——這會是判斷『此案例是否會重演Cisco/Citrix式的揭露即武器化』的第一手訊號。
implication.en: The operational takeaway for conversations with decision-makers: first, draw a clear line between this case and this site's recent Tier-0 edge-device cases (Cisco Secure Email Gateway, Citrix NetScaler, Ivanti VPN) — those cases share the feature that attackers were already exploiting them at disclosure, whereas these six Oracle perfect-score flaws, per Oracle's current public statement, follow the traditional pattern of 'discovered and patched first, weaponization (if any) comes later.' That distinction is itself worth factoring into your threat-hunting prioritization: core systems like E-Business Suite and Access Manager, which touch financial processes and identity governance (SSO), carry higher value to an attacker than a plain edge VPN appliance once in-the-wild exploitation is confirmed, because the former directly touches financial records and lateral-movement identity infrastructure. For your own or client environments, this is the golden window where the patch gap hasn't been breached yet — the key checkpoint for next cycle is whether any of these six CVSS-10.0 flaws lands on CISA's KEV (Known Exploited Vulnerabilities) catalog within the next 2-4 weeks, which would be the first hard signal on whether this case repeats the Cisco/Citrix pattern of weaponization-at-disclosure.

counterpoint.zh: Oracle的季度CPU歷來規模都很大(過去幾期也常見逾千筆修補)，單純用『修補數量』或『CVSS滿分筆數』做跨期比較容易失真，因為這部分反映的是Oracle產品線本身的龐大與複雜，不必然代表威脅情勢本身升高；『尚未列入已遭利用』也只是現有公開資訊的現狀，不代表未來不會被利用，更不能排除已有未公開個案正在發生。
counterpoint.en: Oracle's quarterly CPUs have historically been large in scope (recent cycles also routinely exceed a thousand fixes), so comparing raw patch counts or the number of perfect CVSS scores across periods can be misleading — this largely reflects the sheer size and complexity of Oracle's product line rather than a rise in threat conditions per se. 'Not yet flagged as exploited' also only reflects the current state of public information; it doesn't mean exploitation won't happen later, nor can it rule out an undisclosed case already underway.

items.source: Oracle Critical Patch Update（官方公告，經SecurityWeek／CIO／CSOonline與Tenable分析轉述）

title.zh: PHP2Shell新增兩筆實證：Amazon蜜罐證實攻擊早於正式揭露4天就已發動、至少五國政府網站已主動下線預防——相較10/24與10/26報告的曝險規模推估，本次是制度性回應的第一手證據
title.en: PHP2Shell Gains Two New Data Points: Amazon's Honeypot Confirms Exploitation Began Four Days Before Formal Disclosure, and at Least Five Governments Have Proactively Pulled Sites Offline — the First Hard Evidence of Institutional Response, Beyond the Exposure-Scale Estimates in the 10/24 and 10/26 Reports

summary.zh: 本站10/24報告已收錄PHP2Shell(CVE-2026-109618、CVE-2026-109619)的漏洞細節與修補時程，10/26報告進一步收錄CybelAngel估算的224萬台曝險主機與59%不可修補比例。本次新增兩筆此前未記錄的事實：第一，Amazon資安團隊公布其MadPot誘捕系統證實，攻擊者最早在10/17——也就是PHP官方10/21正式揭露並發布修補的4天前——就已從一個被定位在澳洲的匿名化IP位址嘗試利用，Cloudflare執行長則形容攻擊嘗試量從公告後45分鐘內的『數萬次』暴增到目前的『數百萬次』；這代表PHP2Shell從一開始就是真正的在野零時差，而非『揭露後才被武器化』的案例。第二，澳洲網路安全中心(ACSC)10/21發布其最高等級的緊急警示，法國、芬蘭、丹麥、荷蘭至少四國的政府機構已將部分網站主動下線作為預防措施——這是制度性、主動斷線的回應模式，而非被動等待確診入侵案例後才行動，且截至目前查核，仍未出現任何一起被證實的大規模淪陷個案，與10/26報告的查核方向(應鎖定『是否被打包進自動化掃描常態清單』)一致，本次尚無新的突破性證據。
summary.en: This site's 10/24 report already logged PHP2Shell's (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) technical details and patch timeline, and the 10/26 report added CybelAngel's estimate of 2.24 million exposed hosts with 59% permanently unpatchable. This cycle adds two previously unrecorded facts. First, Amazon's security team disclosed that its MadPot honeypot system confirmed exploitation attempts as early as 10/17 — four days before PHP's official 10/21 disclosure and patch — originating from an anonymized IP address geolocated to Australia; Cloudflare's CEO described attempt volume surging from 'tens of thousands' in the 45 minutes after disclosure to 'millions' now. This confirms PHP2Shell was a genuine in-the-wild zero-day from the start, not a case weaponized only after disclosure. Second, Australia's Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) issued its highest-level emergency alert on 10/21, and government bodies in at least four countries — France, Finland, Denmark, Netherlands — have proactively taken some government websites offline as a precaution. This is an institutional, proactive-disconnection response pattern rather than waiting for a confirmed breach before acting, and as of this check, no confirmed large-scale compromise case has yet surfaced — consistent with the 10/26 report's flagged checkpoint (whether this gets folded into routine automated scan lists), with no breakthrough evidence either way this cycle.

implication.zh: 對你做威脅獵捕與provenance graph建模的操作意義：『攻擊在揭露前4天就已開始』這個事實本身，改變了你回溯調查這類事件時該設定的時間窗——如果你的環境在10/17之後、10/21修補前曾運作任何版本的PHP，這段期間都應該被納入鑑識範圍，而不是只從官方揭露日開始回溯，Amazon自己也明確建議檢查回溯到10/17的紀錄。第二個重點是政府回應模式的轉變：至少五國選擇在『尚無確診入侵』的狀態下主動斷線，這代表部分國家級機構已經把『曝險規模加上無法修補比例』本身，當成啟動應變程序的充分條件，不再等待第一起確診案例——這對你評估類似規模的曝險事件時提供了一個新的比較基準：當你看到下一個『數百萬台曝險、高比例不可修補』的漏洞公告時，可以用『有沒有國家級機構選擇主動下線』作為判斷這次事件被官方認真對待程度的指標，而不是只看媒體熱度。對PHP2Shell本身而言，截至目前仍未出現確診大規模淪陷案例，10/26報告設下的查核點(1-2週內是否浮現真實案例)仍然有效，尚未到期，下一期應持續追蹤。
implication.en: For threat-hunting and provenance-graph modeling, the fact that exploitation began four days before disclosure itself changes the time window you should set for retrospective investigation of this class of incident — if your environment ran any version of PHP between 10/17 and the 10/21 patch, that window needs to be in forensic scope, not just the official disclosure date forward; Amazon itself explicitly recommends checking logs back to 10/17. The second key point is the shift in government response pattern: at least five countries chose to proactively disconnect while no breach was yet confirmed, meaning some state-level institutions now treat 'exposure scale plus unpatchable percentage' alone as sufficient grounds to trigger response procedures, without waiting for a first confirmed case. That gives you a new comparison benchmark for assessing similarly scaled exposure events going forward: when you see the next 'millions exposed, high percentage unpatchable' vulnerability disclosure, whether any state-level institution chooses to proactively go offline is a better indicator of how seriously the incident is being taken officially than media attention alone. For PHP2Shell itself, no confirmed mass-compromise case has surfaced as of this check — the checkpoint the 10/26 report set (whether a real case emerges within 1-2 weeks) remains open and not yet due; it should keep being tracked next cycle.

items.source: Amazon Security（官方部落格，經TheHackernews／Cybernews轉述）、Cloudflare執行長公開發言、ACSC緊急警示

title.zh: 記憶體超級循環Q3數據浮現：DRAM合約價年增率約150%，9/14週報『HBM管制沒擋住中國、但把自主路線變成一項稅』的稅率這次有了季度量化基準
title.en: Memory Supercycle's Q3 Numbers Surface: DRAM Contract Prices Up Roughly 150% Year-on-Year — the 9/14 Weekly's 'HBM Controls Didn't Stop China, They Turned Self-Reliance Into a Tax' Finally Gets a Quarterly Rate

summary.zh: 供應鏈數據商Supplyframe的資料(經Findchips轉述)顯示，記憶體現貨與合約價格2026年第三季較去年同期上漲約150%，交期在第三季隨供給吃緊而延長後，季底開始略為縮短。另據TrendForce的分析(經Utmel轉述)，傳統DRAM合約價第一季季增93%-98%、第二季再季增58%-63%，第三季預估季增收斂到13%-18%——漲幅本身正在收斂，但方向仍是上漲，而非反轉下跌。這一輪漲價的結構性原因是：生產HBM與生產傳統DRAM共用同一批晶圓產能，而HBM單位晶圓面積消耗約為傳統DRAM的三倍，意味著每多轉一片晶圓產能去做HBM，被犧牲掉的傳統DRAM位元數遠大於一比一。SK海力士與TEAMGROUP等業者先前已預期HBM供給緊張將延續到2027年甚至更後。
summary.en: Supply-chain data provider Supplyframe's figures (relayed via Findchips) show memory spot and contract prices up roughly 150% year-on-year in Q3 2026, with lead times that had extended through Q2 beginning to shorten slightly by quarter-end. Separately, TrendForce's analysis (relayed via Utmel) shows conventional DRAM contract prices rising 93-98% quarter-on-quarter in Q1, a further 58-63% QoQ in Q2, with Q3 projected to moderate to 13-18% QoQ — the rate of increase is converging, but the direction remains upward, not a reversal into decline. The structural cause of this price cycle is that HBM and conventional DRAM production share the same wafer capacity, and HBM consumes roughly three times the wafer area per unit as conventional DRAM — meaning every additional wafer shifted to HBM sacrifices far more than a one-for-one amount of conventional DRAM bit output. SK hynix and TEAMGROUP executives have previously said they expect HBM supply tightness to persist through 2027 or beyond.

implication.zh: 9/14週報的核心論點是：『HBM管制沒有擋住中國做AI晶片，它把自主路線變成一項稅——而稅率不是華府訂的，是2026年記憶體超級循環訂的』。這次浮現的季度數字，第一次把這個『稅率』量化到可以逐季追蹤的程度：如果你要評估中國自主記憶體/AI晶片路線的實際成本結構，150%的年增率本身就是一個可以直接代入財務模型的參數，而不必再用『管制生效但效果難以量化』這種定性描述帶過。對你做台股量化操作的操作意義：記憶體超級循環的受益方(美韓記憶體廠、設備供應商)與受害方(任何依賴DDR5/消費性電子的下游廠商)之間的利差，理論上應該會隨這組季增率的收斂(93%→58%→13-18%)而逐步收斂，但只要方向仍是正值而非負值，就代表這一輪漲價循環尚未見頂；下一個查核點是Q4的合約價數字是否轉為季減，那會是判斷『超級循環見頂』的第一個可驗證訊號，而不是任何單一廠商執行長的預測發言。
implication.en: The 9/14 weekly's core argument was: 'the HBM controls did not stop China from building AI chips — they turned self-reliance into a tax, and Washington doesn't set the rate, the 2026 memory supercycle does.' This quarter's numbers are the first time that 'tax rate' gets quantified to a trackable, quarter-by-quarter level: if you're assessing the actual cost structure of China's self-reliant memory/AI-chip path, a 150% year-on-year figure is a parameter you can plug directly into a financial model, rather than relying on a qualitative 'controls are in effect but hard to quantify' description. For Taiwan-equities quant purposes: the spread between beneficiaries of the memory supercycle (US/Korean memory makers, equipment suppliers) and those hurt by it (any downstream firm dependent on DDR5 or consumer electronics) should, in theory, narrow as this sequence of QoQ growth rates converges (93%→58%→13-18%) — but as long as the direction stays positive rather than negative, this price cycle hasn't peaked yet. The next checkpoint is whether Q4 contract prices actually turn to a QoQ decline — that would be the first verifiable signal the supercycle has peaked, rather than any single executive's forward-looking statement.
